chunks.text: Welcome to the Slow English podcast.
In this podcast, we speak very slowly.
Part two, Slovakia in simple words.
Slovakia is a country in Central Europe.
Bratislava shows the Slovak way of life.
Bratislava is the capital city of Slovakia.
A big river flows through the city.
Bratislava and the river belong together.
Part six, a city with long history.
The city was important in history.
You can feel the past in the air.
It is the heart of the city.
The old town feels friendly and warm.
The castle stands on a hill.
From the castle, you see the city.
The past looks over the present.
Part nine, daily life of people.
They work, they rest, they meet friends, they drink coffee.
Part 12, the soul of Bratislava and goodbye Bratislava is gentle.
History and daily life live together.
Thank you for listening to the Slow English Podcast.
See you in the next long journey.
